senses.gloss: m. (v. זרג a. denom. P. Sm. 1154) zargon, name of a plant, prob. a species of beet.
units: Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ bot. ז׳ ולפת z. crossed with carrot. [It is evident that our w. cannot mean a vine-shoot, as Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, 564, a. Löw Pfl. p. 87 suggest.—R. S. to Kil. I, 4 reads וגדין or זגדין.]
